slide.headline: The Architecture: Two Tiers, Eight Outcomes
slide.body:
Tier 1: 36 regex patterns classify 60-70% of replies in under 10ms.

- Interested = steered toward booking
- Neutral = qualifying questions sent
- Not Interested = soft re-engagement drafted
- Do Not Contact = all automation stopped instantly

Confidence score (0-1.0) on every classification. Above 0.40 = auto-action. Below = human review. Conservative teams run 0.60.

slide.headline: Static Lists Guarantee Failure
slide.body: Scraping 10,000 leads at once feels productive. But treating a static CSV as evergreen guarantees diminishing returns.
